criticalFinding.summary: YamlLocalRunner is an ENGINE harness, not an adapter harness. Program.cs:114 constructs IntegrationEngine directly and Program.cs:71 loads the definition itself, bypassing YamlCollectorAdapter, runtime discovery, the Shared orchestration pipeline, checkpointing and the sinks.
criticalFinding.consequence: The two live vendor collections run earlier this session are evidence about the ENGINE PACKAGE only. They say nothing about the 18 host files this task ports. The parity gate cannot rest on YamlLocalRunner.
